title: DataFolder
description: The visible marker file, maipai-folder.json, at the top of every class folder (home docs/dev.md, 'DATA-LOCATION', section (a)). It says which household, which class and which generation of that class the folder is, and whether a move has retired it. Exactly one folder on a machine matches (householdFolderId, class, generation) for a class, and that folder is the class's live one; a retired folder is refused and never used. The file is visible on purpose, so a person who opens the folder is told what it is. It carries no volume identity: the location record does.

schema.description: The marker's own version. Nothing wrote an earlier shape, so it starts at 1.

product.description: The product that owns the folder.

class.description: The class id (see data-class.schema.json) of the data the folder holds.

householdFolderId.description: The household's folder id from the location record (a ULID). A folder whose id differs belongs to another household or install.

generation.description: The class's generation this folder is the live one for. Goes up by one on every move of the class, and a moved-to folder is stamped with the new number.

moveId.description: The id of the move (a ULID) that created this folder, when a move did. Absent for a folder made by the installer or adoption.

retired.description: Present only after a confirmed move left this folder behind. Nothing else in the marker changes when it is set. A retired folder is never used, and only a folder retired by a given move is ever offered for deletion by that move.

movedTo.description: The absolute path the class's data moved to.

moveId.description: The move (a ULID) that retired the folder.

note.description: A plain sentence for a person who opens the folder: 'This folder holds part of a MaiPai Home household's data (class: people-files). MaiPai uses it while Settings > Storage lists it; do not delete or move it by hand.'
